data.long_meaning: Qilabah is a unique and beautiful name that symbolizes strength, resilience, and beauty. In Islamic tradition, it is believed to represent a branch of a tree that remains strong and steadfast even in the face of adversity. The name Qilabah carries the meaning “Branch of a tree” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Qilabah usually hope their child will grow to embody branch of a tree and live with faith, good character and purpose.
